bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; providing direction to the Office of the Legislative Auditor to evaluate the postsecondary enrollment options program; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+REQUEST TO OFFICE OF LEGISLATIVE AUDITOR. +]

[+The Office of the Legislative Auditor is requested to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the postsecondary enrollment options program established under Minnesota Statutes, section 124D.09, and prepare a report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over kindergarten through grade 12 education. The requested report must be completed by January 15, 2027, and must include an evaluation of educational benefits for students participating in the program and fiscal impacts on school districts. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; providing direction to the Office of the Legislative Auditor to evaluate the postsecondary enrollment options program; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. REQUEST TO OFFICE OF LEGISLATIVE AUDITOR.

The Office of the Legislative Auditor is requested to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the postsecondary enrollment options program established under Minnesota Statutes, section 124D.09, and prepare a report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over kindergarten through grade 12 education. The requested report must be completed by January 15, 2027, and must include an evaluation of educational benefits for students participating in the program and fiscal impacts on school districts.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
